Hi Rachel —

Looking forward to the demo during your site-week next Wednesday (Nov 11). Per our notes we planned a 45-minute walkthrough of the inference pipeline and a 15-minute Q&A. Two quick asks before I lock the calendar:

- Can you confirm the decision-makers who will attend (names/titles)?
- Do you want this in the customer conference room (on-site) or should we plan for a hybrid set-up?

I've attached a short outline of topics we intend to cover; happy to trim it. If anything changes with travel plans let me know — we can either run the session remotely, record the walkthrough, and hold a 30-minute live office-hours slot for your team.

Proposed window: 2:30–3:30pm PT (we can shift earlier by 1 hour).

Thanks —

Thanks for the outline. Heads up: our VP of Ops unexpectedly asked me to join a client site visit that day (out of town, back late Friday). That knocks me out of the live slot on Wednesday. Tom and I still really want to see the demo — could we either:

2) Move the live walkthrough to Thursday afternoon if your team has availability.

Option 1 is probably safest for us (we have a training block Thursday morning). If you send a recording + a short list of time slots for Friday office-hours we can pick one.

Apologies for the last-minute shuffle — travel got pulled into the calendar this morning.
